# technitium_cluster_secondary (Resource)

Joins this server (use a provider alias pointing at it) to a cluster as a Secondary node. Joining overwrites this server's Allowed, Blocked, Apps, Settings and Administration config with the Primary's. Destroying leaves the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "technitium" {
  alias    = "dns2"
  host     = "http://192.168.1.3:5380"
  username = "admin"
  password = var.dns2_admin_password
}

resource "technitium_cluster_secondary" "dns2" {
  provider                  = technitium.dns2
  primary_node_url          = technitium_cluster.this.nodes[0].url
  primary_node_ip_address   = "192.168.1.2"
  primary_node_username     = "admin"
  primary_node_password     = var.dns1_admin_password
  ignore_certificate_errors = true
  ip_addresses              = ["192.168.1.3"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_addresses` (List of String) This node's addresses reachable by the other nodes.
- `primary_node_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of that administrator; only used to join.
- `primary_node_url` (String) HTTPS web service URL of the Primary, e.g. `https://dns1.example.com:53443/`.
- `primary_node_username` (String) Administrator on the Primary; only used to join.

### Optional

- `force_leave_on_destroy` (Boolean) On destroy, leave without notifying the Primary (when it is gone).
- `ignore_certificate_errors` (Boolean) Accept the Primary's self-signed certificate (private networks only).
- `primary_node_ip_address` (String) Primary's IP address, if its name in the URL doesn't resolve from here.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_domain` (String) Cluster domain.
- `id` (String) This node's name in the cluster.
- `nodes` (List of Object) Cluster nodes as seen from this node. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `server_domain` (String) This server's name in the cluster.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `ip_addresses` (List of String)
- `name` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
